# StrataBench

> Agentic, honest storage benchmarking — HDD, NVMe, AFA, S3 RDMA, VM, and application workloads.

## For AI agents

- Read AGENTS.md for MCP tools, CLI commands, and REST API
- Claude Code: `.mcp.json` at repo root (auto-loaded)
- Devin: `.devin/mcp_config.json` + AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md
- Cursor: `.cursor/skills/stratabench/SKILL.md` + `examples/mcp-cursor.json`
- MCP server: `cmd/stratabench-mcp` — 14 tools for plan, guide, validate, run, analyze, compare, report
- Lab workflow: `lab bootstrap` → `lab run <profile>` from `lab.yaml` with `targets:` section
- Reports: HTML + Excel + PDF under `~/.stratabench/reports/`
- Default to mock mode unless user confirms real hardware targets
- 30+ profiles in `profiles/`; engines: fio, vdbench, SPDK, warp, elbencho, sbk

## Key commands

```
stratabench agent "intent" --target <path> --mock
stratabench plan "intent" --llm
stratabench validate --profile <name> --target <path>
stratabench lab run -f lab.yaml hdd-sequential-read
stratabench sbk tools
```

## LLM env

STRATABENCH_LLM_PROVIDER, STRATABENCH_LLM_URL, STRATABENCH_LLM_API_KEY, STRATABENCH_LLM_MODEL
